name: Warding Bell AP OLD
description: At the heart of the shrine hangs a massive bronze temple bell.
disable: Ringing the bell as an Interact action eight times in succession with the ceremonial ringer (carried by Mago Kai) over the course of three consecutive rounds automatically deactivates the hazard, DC 36 Thievery to extinguish the flame within the bell, DC 36 Religion to appeal to Pharasma to extinguish the flame, or dispel magic or a shimmerthief's Drain Light (6th level; counteract DC 29)
reset: Reactivating the warding bell requires a complicated rite taking several days.
routine:
(1 action; divine, emotion, enchantment, fear, mental) The warding bell emits a harrowing ring that can be heard only by undead or transmigrated PCs in area C11; affected characters must attempt a DC 30 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to the warding bell's routine for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes Frightened 1 and takes 6d6 Mental Damage damage.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Frightened 2, takes 12d6 Mental Damage damage, and is Fleeing as long as it remains frightened.

offensiveAbilities.name: Flare Up
offensiveAbilities.description: The warding bell's light increases from a faint flickering to luminous enough that the whole room is brightly lit. The hazard then rolls initiative.
